glossary.title: Glossary of terms
glossary.subtitle: Definitions of the acronyms and technical terms used across this portal.

entries.definition: Documento Nacional de Identidad. The official ID document of Spanish citizens.
Número de Identificación Fiscal. The Spanish tax identification number for individuals and legal entities.
One-Time Password. A temporary numeric code sent by email or SMS to authorise an operation.
Mutual TLS. A variant of the TLS protocol in which both the server and the client (the browser) present a digital certificate to authenticate each other.
Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre. The Spanish public body that issues personal digital certificates recognised by the Public Administration.
European Union. Licence plates carrying the blue «EU» band are issued in EU member states.
United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. {city} has been on the UNESCO World Heritage list since 2001.
